explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because the upstream provenance handoff changes evidence_sources.record_id from the retained demand record identities (n06-r01...n06-r08) to source identities (s01...s08). Job 2 then cannot join provenance ranks back to coverage records, so every priority row has upstream_rank 0, violating the requirement to preserve upstream provenance order. The visible source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which sets record_id from source_id.
cited_evidence: Job 1 needs output preserves demand record_ids n06-r01 through n06-r08, but evidence_sources output uses record_id values s01 through s08.
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record identity with the source_id.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks it up with coverage record_id; Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for all records.
